events.title: Lumen Posts Wider-Than-Expected Q1 Loss, Revenues Drop Y/Y
events.body: LUMN posts wider Q1 loss as revenues fall 9%, while strategic sales hit 51% and an Alkira deal targets faster-growing east-west cloud connectivity.

events.title: Primoris Services (PRIM) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Lag Estimates
events.body: Primoris Services (PRIM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -31.99% and -10.02%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Q1 2026 Telecom Wars: Analyst Eye 30% Gains in T-Mobile Post-Earnings
events.body: Telecom giants reported solid results in Q1 2026. Analysts are particularly bullish on T-Mobile going forward, projecting over 30% upside.
